affected_component: product_jobs._self_check_repair_rounds stall budget + draft_selfcheck.MAX_TOTAL_REPAIR_ROUNDS hard cap
invariant: The self-check repair bound is a stall budget, not a repair count: a repair spends it only when the failure it faces (first reason code + first diagnostic line) has already been seen in this self-check; a repair facing a brand-new failure is progress and is free. A hard cap (MAX_TOTAL_REPAIR_ROUNDS) still bounds the total number of repairs, every attempt is recorded as its own round, and a persistently identical failure therefore gets one free attempt plus the stall budget before the loop stops.
